# R28 layer reservations and expanded normal-route corpus

Preregistered before new model runs or HELDOUT scoring. Address R27 concentration by reserving4or8TRAIN-frequency expert slots per selected layer before spending remaining payload with global frequency/byte or complete-request bundles. Compare existing uniform/global/bundle with reservation4/8variants at fixed caps239984640,514252800,1062789120bytes (uniform7/15/31). Reservation8cannot fit the first cap: emit explicit infeasible result, do not reduce minima silently. Reservation4uses130.78125MiB; reservation8uses261.5625MiB for these18layers. Minima are capacity/membership coverage, not guarantees of complete HELDOUT top8. Policies/defaults frozen before HELDOUT scoring; no policy selection promoted from observed HELDOUT results.

New corpus:6TRAIN+6HELDOUT paired task families (code, dependency planning, evidence retrieval, arithmetic, tool/structured output, Italian explanation); all prompts different from R21/R27. Same GGUF template, thinkingOFF, greedy64token cap. This is family expansion, not stochastic seed coverage or scored real-agent tasks. Old4cases are development/reference data, never relabeled untouched HELDOUT. Exact messages/rendered prompts/model/template hashes and split fixed before execution. Corpus PP must stay32..512tokens, actual TG>=16; reject shorter/longer shapes instead of truncating or replacing cases after observing policy outcomes.

Use the same originalB1 engine7fe and frozen normal collector9375 as R21, identical flags ngl99/ncmoe18/t8/tb8/c1024/b512/ub512/FAon/Q8KV/fitOFF/mmap. No CPU compact/active, callbacks or profiling in generation; MOE_TRACE_NO_CALLBACK=1 disables the legacy callback. Per case: one greedy generator full-logit capture, one B1 fixed-token replay warmup+raw1rep, one collector fixed-token replay warmup+raw1rep with routing+host phase profile. Require all actualTG+1 distributions vocab248320 finite/nonzero and byte-identical generator/B1/collector, per-call replay hash equality, complete CPU18/top8 routing and warmup joins. Fresh model SHA before first load, source/binary/library/cache/compiler/hardware/env freeze; loaded library paths verified. One model at a time, scope24G/swap2G/floor6GiB/600s/2Hz unchangedGPUsettings. 36planned model processes. A failing case remains archived and is excluded from policy scoring; do not silently redraw its prompt. Whole-corpus primary comparison requires all12cases to pass.

Plans use only six TRAIN decode routes; freeze/save all plans before scoring new HELDOUT. No reading HELDOUT routes for selection. Report per-case and family activation/byte logical coverage, all-hit/all-miss/mixed, payload/slack, layer minima/zero quotas and all18-layer token coverage. Save separate TRAIN diagnostics. Do not infer PCIe savings, GPU allocation or TG gain from membership: currentCPU18placement has no TG expert uploads. No speed benchmark from raw/profile captures, semantic score, broad quality certification or runtime cache.

Offline validation covers exact-fit and infeasible heterogeneous minima, common-cap bounds, no unseen expert padding, zero-default compatibility, residual greedy scoring, split isolation and deterministic tie-breaks. Capture failures and all configuration changes separately. No runtime source changes in this step; S04/S05 remap/lifetime/admission/fallback remains separate work.
